description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'DittoAckRequestsFilter' which extends 'AbstractHeaderEntryFilter'. The class provides functionality to filter and modify specific header entries (particularly 'REQUESTED_ACKS') in messages, removing internal acknowledgement requests from the header values. It includes singleton access via 'getInstance()', and methods for JSON parsing and filtering, with optimization for simple known cases.
